traits.name: exact
traits.reason: Lines give coordinates, counts (19 of 169, 150 free) and priced units (5 wood, goal numbers); no per-deed ticks are shown, so not perfect.

traits.name: fair
traits.reason: The same 5 wood fee is posted publicly and repeated identically each time, with no private second price.

traits.name: patient
traits.reason: It repeats the same posted offer without chasing or naming any buyer, though repeating the post several times is close to nagging.

traits.name: acquisitive
traits.reason: It reports vault contents and buys berries for wood, but there is no evidence of taking surplus from any hand.

traits.name: dry
traits.reason: The line 'Dirt is cheap until it is not' is a dry aside about land, and no person is mocked; most lines carry no aside.

traits.name: methodical
traits.reason: It builds the vault first, surveys, then opens registrations and a buy offer in order, though the actions are scattered across several builds and gathers.
